name: Semight Instruments Co. Ltd.
summary: Semight Instruments Co.,Ltd. provides test and measurement instruments and equipment. The firm focuses on the research and development and manufacturing of test instruments and equipment in the fields of high-speed communications, optical chips, electronic chips and power wafer chips. It is a supplier with high-performance test instruments, high-precision automation and semiconductor ATE comprehensive capabilities. The firm provides high-end test instruments including broadband sampling oscilloscopes, clock recovery units, high-speed bit error testers, high-precision fast wavelength meters, precision digital source meters, low-leakage matrix switches, as well as high-end test equipment such as semiconductor laser CoC aging, bare chip testing, silicon photonic wafer testing, SiC wafer aging, SiC power bare chip KGD test sorting and WAT wafer semiconductor parameter test systems. The company was founded on March 15, 2017 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
